title: Likelihood to recommend or repurchase
summary: The fragments center on purchase or recommendation likelihood, with one clear endorsement and one ambiguous statement about future buying.

positive.summary: Positive feedback expresses a clear willingness to recommend the car.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mentions this may be the last one bought, but the reason or sentiment is unclear from the fragment alone.

limitations: The topic is based on only two short fragments, so examples are insufficient for broader conclusions.
One fragment is ambiguous and does not explain why it may be the last purchase.
The keyword groups recommendation intent and repurchase intent, which are related but not identical subjects.
